Daily study (technical_analysis): Opening-range breakout is a daytrade construct: do not promote a 5–60 minute ORH print into a 3–90 day swing entry — wait for daily acceptance (or a daily NR compression break) instead - Toby Crabel's Opening Range Breakout (ORB) defines the high and low of the first N minutes of the RTH session (commonly 5, 30, or 60) and trades a break of that opening-range high (ORH) or low (ORL).
